# Foundations

Before you can control a robot, you need to control the hardware.
Part 1 builds everything from scratch — no Arduino, no HAL, no
abstraction layers you did not write yourself.

By the end of Part 1 you will have:

- A working bare metal development environment
- Direct control of GPIO, timers, and interrupts
- Full understanding of UART, I2C, and SPI from first principles
- A running serial dashboard streaming live data to your PC

Everything in Parts 2–5 builds on what you establish here.
